svg.title: One tree, cut twice
svg.desc: A circular dendrogram: 418 leaves on the rim, the root at the centre. A grey circle marks the cut into 7 chapters; a dark arc in each chapter marks its cut into sections; the outer ring shows the 38 sections with their article numbers.
svg.text: Ward’s method joins the 418 passages into one
tree; it is cut into 7 chapters, and each chapter
into sections: 38 in all, one article each.
The whole and my place in it
Praise, harm and the worth of things
a section, with its article number
